Core calculation formula (by input variables): totalRowLen × (rowGap + 0.5); Math.ceil(shelfNeeded ÷ perRow); layerLen × 100

map.图书馆开馆/扩容规划：新建阅览室按藏书量反推所需书架数与排布，输入层数、层长、书: Library opening/expansion planning: for a new reading room, back-calculate required shelf count and layout from collection size; enter layers, layer length, book thickness and fill rate to compute per-shelf capacity and rows, estimating occupied area.
map.密集书库改造：把单面架改双面架（面数=2）可成倍扩容；在层数与层长受限时，用本工: Dense stack renovation: converting single-face shelves to double-face (faces=2) multiplies capacity; when layers and layer length are limited, use this tool to compare single/double-face plans and choose the most cost-effective layout.
map.书厚不均的估算：不同类目书厚差异大（工具书厚、期刊薄），用平均书厚与填充率（如: Estimating uneven book thickness: thickness varies greatly by category (reference books thick, journals thin); use average thickness and a fill rate (e.g. 90%) to leave margin, avoiding inability to fit after full shelving.
map.算例：6 层 · 层长 2m · 双面 · 书厚 3cm · 填充 90% ·: Example: 6 layers · layer length 2 m · double-face · book thickness 3 cm · fill 90% · target 5000 books
map.每层册数 = 层长(cm)×填充率÷书厚 = 200×0.9÷3 = 60 册；: Books per layer = layer length (cm) × fill rate ÷ book thickness = 200×0.9÷3 = 60 books; per shelf = 60×6×2 (double-face) = 720 books; shelves needed = ceil(5000÷720) = 7; rows = ceil(7÷5) = 2 rows; total shelving length = shelves per row 5 × layer length 2 m × rows 2 = 20 m; aisle total length = 2×1.2 m = 2.4 m; estimated area = total shelving length 20 m × (aisle 1.2 m + estimated shelf depth 0.5 m) = 34.0 m².
map.常用 85%-95%；越低越保险但浪费空间。工具书、画册取低值，普通图书可取 9: Commonly 85%-95%; lower is safer but wastes space. Reference books and albums take lower values; ordinary books can take about 90%, leaving margin for spine thickness and shelving, avoiding inability to insert after full shelving.
map.单架容量 = 每层册数 × 层数 × 面数；双面架面数=2，容量约为单面架的 2: Per-shelf capacity = books per layer × layers × faces; double-face has faces=2, about 2× a single-face shelf. Total shelving length = single-face layer length × shelves per row × rows; area is a rough estimate, and walls and end shelves must still be counted in practice.
map.图书馆书架容量与占地规划: Library Shelf Capacity and Floor-Plan Planning
map.每层可放册数 = ⌊层长(cm) × 填充率 ÷ 图书厚度(cm)⌋: Books per layer = ⌊layer length (cm) × fill rate ÷ book thickness (cm)⌋
map.单架容量 = 每层册数 × 层数 × 面数（双面架记 2）: Capacity per shelf = books per layer × layers × sides (double-sided = 2)
map.所需书架数 = ⌈总馆藏量 ÷ 单架容量⌉: Shelves needed = ⌈total collection ÷ capacity per shelf⌉
map.单排长度 = 每排架数 × 每层长度(米): Row length = shelves per row × layer length (m)
map.排架总长 = 单排长度 × 排数；通道总长 = 排数 × 排间距: Total shelving length = row length × rows; total aisle length = rows × row gap
map.估算面积 = 排架总长 × (通道宽 + 0.5m 架深): Estimated area = total shelving length × (aisle width + 0.5 m shelf depth)
map.填充率建议 80%~90%，预留取书空间: Recommended fill rate 80%–90% to leave room for retrieving books
map.可视化：逐层按 册数×书厚 ÷ 层长 换算填充比例条: Visualization: per-layer fill bar = books × thickness ÷ layer length
map.实际面积需结合阅览区、工作区综合规划: Actual area must also account for reading and work zones
